overview_description.description: Mother Being is a digital platform that provides evidence-based and culture-centered sexual and reproductive health education for women in the MENA region. Its sole mission is to arm women with the information they need, regardless of societal norms, to learn and make informed decisions about their bodies and their reproductive health.

about_short_description.short_description: Mother Being is a digital platform that provides sexual and reproductive health education for women.

product.name: Fertility & Pregnancy & Postpartum
product.description: Covers fertility tracking, family planning, pregnancy follow-up, and postpartum care.

product.name: Sexual Health & Infections
product.description: Includes routine medical checkups, educational sessions, and information on sexual health.

product.name: Contraception
product.description: Offers guidance on choosing contraceptive methods through medical consultations and educational content.

product.name: Menstrual Health & Menopause
product.description: Involves medical checkups, tests, and education on menstrual and hormonal health.

product.name: PCOS
product.description: Provides holistic care for PCOS through regular checkups, hormonal tests, and nutrition advice.

product.name: Cancer prevention
product.description: Focuses on HPV education, pap smear testing, and HPV vaccination.
